_about: The tutorial script. Each step: what the characters say, then (optionally) a task the player must do before the next step. Speakers are character codes from the Characters page; {player}, {teacher} and {hacker} become names. Goals: placed:<item>, owns:<item>, link:<item>:<item>.

say: Hey, {player}! I’m {teacher}. Welcome to your garage: every great network starts somewhere.
Right now it’s just you and a busted laptop. Let’s get it online, so it starts earning credits for you.
First, the laptop. Open your inventory (I), click the laptop, then click the glowing spot on the workbench. You’ll carry it over yourself.
steps.task: Place your laptop on the workbench.

say: Nice! A laptop on its own can’t reach the internet, though. It needs a router.
Open the shop (B) and buy a home router. You started with enough credits for one.
steps.task: Buy a home router in the shop.

say: Got it. Put it on the shelf: pick it in your inventory, then click the glowing shelf spot.
steps.task: Place the home router on the shelf.

say: Devices talk through cables. Buy a pack of copper cable: that’s the straight-through kind, for joining a router to the ISP box and your laptop.
steps.task: Buy a pack of copper cable.

say: Now the important bit. That box on the wall is the ISP box: your connection to the internet.
Pick the cable tool (C). Click the ISP box and choose its LAN port, then click your router and choose its WAN port.
steps.task: Cable the ISP box’s LAN port to the router’s WAN port.

say: The router’s online! Last link: plug your laptop’s Eth0 port into one of the router’s LAN ports.
steps.task: Cable the laptop to a router LAN port.

say: You’re online! See the coins popping out? Your network now earns credits every second. Watch the wallet at the top.
Spend them in the shop, but it only sells what your level allows. You level up by learning: press L for lessons.
Be a shame if someone… came knocking.
Ignore them. That’s {hacker}, and they’ll be back. Learn your lessons and you’ll stop every attack.
That’s the basics. Open Learn (L) whenever you’re ready. Good luck!

attack: Found a door. Mind if I come in?
